title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1, section 2 (Columbia Lake and River)
heading: Columbia Lake and River
state: Approved, but approximate: zone around the places named
sourceText:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Columbia Lake and River
2 That portion of the Province, in the vicinity of Columbia Lake, Kootenay Land District, that is within the following boundaries: The portion of the Columbia River and Columbia Lake, below the high water level and including all marshes, sand and gravel bars, located in M.U.s 4-25 and 4-26 bounded at the south on Columbia Lake by a straight line running between the southeast corner of Lot 450, Kootenay Land District, and the mouth of Warspite Creek, and at the north by the south side of the Highway 93/95 bridge over the Columbia River.
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
